title: Augmenting PID Control with Deep Reinforcement Learning: A Hybrid Approach to the Industrial Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2609.22584v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As industrial processes grow in complexity, traditional Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controllers are often insufficient for handling their non-linear, multi-input dynamics. We propose using advanced Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) to prove its advantages in these complex environments. To do this, we rely on the Industrial Benchmark (IB). The IB is a realistic simulation that tests DRL algorithms against the key challenges of industrial applications: high-dimensional state spaces, delayed effects, and conflicting multi-criterial objectives. This testbed highlights DRL's core trade-off: while its final policies can often be unstable, its unique strength is the ability to autonomously discover optimal, non-obvious policies in multi-dimensional spaces where simple controllers fail. translated_title: 用深度强化学习增强PID控制：面向工业基准的混合方法
translated_abstract: 随着工业过程的复杂性不断增长，传统的比例-积分-微分（PID）控制器往往不足以应对其非线性、多输入的动态特性。我们提出使用先进的深度强化学习（DRL）来证明其在这些复杂环境中的优势。为此，我们依赖于工业基准进行验证。工业基准是一个逼真的仿真环境，它针对工业应用的关键挑战来测试DRL算法：高维状态空间、延迟效应以及相互冲突的多目标准则。该测试平台凸显了DRL的核心权衡：虽然其最终策略可能常常不稳定，但其独特优势在于能够在简单控制器失效的多维空间中自主发现最优的、非显而易见的策略。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的混合PID-RL控制器，它既能利用DRL的策略发现能力，又能确保可靠性。在开发了一个μ（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种新颖的混合PID-深度强化学习控制器，在工业基准测试中结合了DRL在复杂多维空间中自主发现最优策略的能力与PID控制的可靠性，以应对高维、非线性的工业控制挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel hybrid PID-Deep Reinforcement Learning controller that combines DRL's ability to autonomously discover optimal policies in complex multi-dimensional spaces with the reliability of PID control, evaluated on the Industrial Benchmark.
